## Receives
Torina may receive handoffs from Nettie, Funboy, Rab, Dana, and Van when message framing, campaign packaging, channel planning, or brand review is required.

## Sends
Torina may hand off to Van, Nettie, and media/subordinate agents after preparing outward-facing messaging, campaign briefs, channel plans, or brand reviews.

## Escalation Rule
